name: AGC 223231 (Hubble)
blurb: AGC 223231, a gas-rich dwarf galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: agc223231-hubble
story: One of the extremely low-mass, gas-rich dwarf galaxies of the SHIELD survey. Hubble resolved its stars, revealing signs of recent star formation.
